name: Ash Training Blade
description: Mostly a stick, but a confident stick.

name: Hunter's Sling
description: For flinging pebbles with intent.

name: Apprentice Wand
description: Still has the price tag on it.

name: Bramble Saber
description: Grown, not forged. Slightly prickly to hold.

name: Tidecaller Bow
description: The string is always a bit damp.

name: Ember Rod
description: Toasts bread at range.

name: Coral Cutlass
description: Sharp, pink, and fashionable.

name: Frostbite Crossbow
description: Bolts arrive cold.

name: Cinder Staff
description: Warm in winter. Too warm in summer.

name: Magma Maul
description: Heavy, hot, and loud.

name: Galeshot Longbow
description: Arrows hum on the way out.

name: Stonesong Scepter
description: It hums in a very low voice.

name: Thunder Glaive
description: Crackles when you point it at things.

name: Stormwing Bow
description: Made from a feather of something huge.

name: Verdant Codex
description: A spellbook with moss for a bookmark.

name: Padded Vest
description: Like a quilt that believes in you.

name: Leather Jerkin
description: Smells like adventure and old shoes.

name: Shellplate
description: Pieced together from very large shells.

name: Ashguard Mail
description: Fireproof, mostly.

name: Skyforged Plate
description: Light as a cloud, hard as a mountain.

name: Lucky Pebble
description: Probably lucky. Definitely a pebble.

name: Mana Locket
description: Holds a tiny portrait of a tiny wizard.

name: Brawler's Band
description: Knuckles not included.

name: Keeper's Charm
description: Given to keepers who remember to feed their dragon.

name: Stormglass Pendant
description: A little storm in a bottle on a string.

name: Rope Saddle
description: Itchy, but it holds.

name: Ridgeback Saddle
description: Comes with cup holders. Just the one.

name: Iron Horn Cap
description: Makes every headbutt count.

name: Gilded Horn Cap
description: Shiny. Your dragon will not stop looking at itself.

name: River Scale Charm
description: A smooth stone tied into the scales.

name: Ember Scale Charm
description: Glows faintly when your dragon is happy.

name: Rimefang Blade
description: So cold it fogs up when you talk to it.

name: Glacier Longbow
description: Arrows come out pre-chilled.

name: Hoarfrost Staff
description: Leaves a trail of tiny snowflakes.

name: Geode Hammer
description: Cracks rocks open. Cracks golems open too.

name: Crystal Repeater
description: Hums a different note for every shot.

name: Lantern of Ages
description: The flame inside has never gone out.

name: Dawnbreaker
description: A sword that makes everyone squint.

name: Duskwind Bow
description: Very quiet. Suspiciously quiet.

name: Eclipse Tome
description: Half the pages are blank. The other half are glowing.

name: Rimeguard Plate
description: Keeps the cold out and the warm in.

name: Geodeplate
description: Every plate is a polished gemstone.

name: Twilight Mail
description: Changes color with the time of day.

name: Frost Sigil
description: A snowflake that never melts.

name: Miner's Lucky Gem
description: Found at the bottom of a very deep hole.

name: Sun and Moon Charm
description: Half gold, half silver, all fancy.

name: Frost-Fur Saddle
description: Warm, fluffy, slightly shedding.

name: Elder Saddle
description: Fit for a dragon who has seen everything.

name: Crystal Horn Cap
description: Sparkles when your dragon headbutts things.

name: Eclipse Horn Cap
description: Casts a tiny shadow, even indoors.

name: Glacier Scale Charm
description: Breath comes out crisp and clear.

name: Starlight Scale Charm
description: Twinkles at night. Your dragon loves it.

name: Harvest Lantern
description: A paper lantern shaped like a pumpkin. Gold shines brighter by its light.

name: Snowflake Scarf
description: Knitted by someone who really likes snowflakes.

name: Petal Pin
description: A pressed flower that never wilts.

name: Sunburst Amulet
description: Warm on sunny days. Always sunny somewhere.

name: Cobble Cudgel
description: A rock tied to a stick. Classic engineering.

name: Static Slingshot
description: Rub it on a sweater before use.

name: Icicle Wand
description: Keep it out of hot drinks.

name: Sparkbrand Saber
description: Hums a little tune when swung.

name: Briarwood Bow
description: Grown, not made. Still a bit thorny.

name: Pebble Orb
description: Heavier than it looks. Much heavier.

name: Hailstone Axe
description: Leaves a little snow on everything it hits.

name: Riptide Recurve
description: Pulls arrows back like the sea pulls sand.

name: Mossheart Staff
description: Smells like a forest after rain.

name: Boulderbreaker
description: It does what it says.

name: Kindling Longbow
description: Arrows arrive slightly toasted.

name: Tidepool Scepter
description: Has a tiny crab living in it. Don't ask.

name: Emberforged Blade
description: Warm to the touch. Hot to the enemy.

name: Thornstorm Bow
description: Every arrow sprouts on the way.

name: Wavecrest Rod
description: Hums like a seashell held to your ear.

name: Rootsplitter Axe
description: Old oaks fear it. Young oaks have heard stories.

name: Rimeshard Crossbow
description: Bolts of pure ice. Bring mittens.

name: Abyssal Codex
description: Damp pages. Very powerful damp pages.

name: Duskreaver
description: Nobody sees it coming. Sometimes not even you.

name: Dawnstring Bow
description: Arrows that glow like sunrise.

name: Sunlit Grimoire
description: Reading it gives you a mild tan.

name: Traveler's Coat
description: Lots of pockets. Most of them have snacks.

name: Mistweave Robe
description: Slightly damp at all times. On purpose.

name: Cinderweave Cloak
description: Fireproof, mostly.

name: Galecloth Jerkin
description: Flaps heroically even indoors.

name: Snowdrift Mantle
description: Soft as fresh snow, warm as a hug.

name: Deepcavern Leathers
description: Smells faintly of mushrooms and courage.

name: Duskwalker Garb
description: Hard to see at night. Easy to trip over.

name: Featherweight Saddle
description: Barely there. Your dragon loves it.

name: Swiftwind Saddle
description: Built for loops, rolls and showing off.

name: Snowrunner Saddle
description: Sheds snow before it can settle.

name: Skydancer Saddle
description: For dragons who fight like they dance.

name: Serrated Horn Cap
description: Little teeth on the edge. Very rude.

name: Hooked Horn Cap
description: Good for grabbing, better for swiping.

name: Shardtip Horn Cap
description: Crystal points that never dull.

name: Doomspike Horn Cap
description: The name was the blacksmith's idea.

name: Spark Scale Charm
description: Crackles when your dragon sneezes.

name: Hex Scale Charm
description: Scribbled with runes. Some are spelled right.

name: Storm-eye Scale Charm
description: Calm in the middle, chaos all around.

name: Wyrdscale Charm
description: Hums in a key that makes enemies itchy.

name: Bramblewarden Thornblade
description: Grows back if you chip it.

name: Bramblewarden Vine Bow
description: The string is a very patient vine.

name: Bramblewarden Acorn Staff
description: Topped with the biggest acorn in the Hollow.

name: Bramblewarden Bark Mail
description: Made from the Bramble Troll's old bark. It shed it. Probably.

name: Bramblewarden Acorn Charm
description: The Elder Thornling's favorite acorn.

name: Brinewalker Cutlass
description: Salty. Like its owner.

name: Brinewalker Harpoon Bow
description: Fires tiny harpoons. Mostly at crabs.

name: Brinewalker Shell Wand
description: Hold it to your ear and hear spells.

name: Brinewalker Crabshell Coat
description: A gift from the Crab King. He did not mean to give it.

name: Brinewalker Pincher Pearl
description: Big Pincher kept it very safe. Until now.

name: Emberheart Brand
description: Glows red when it is happy.

name: Emberheart Flare Bow
description: Every shot is a tiny firework.

name: Emberheart Coal Scepter
description: Do not lick. We have all tried.

name: Emberheart Wyrmscale Mail
description: Scales the Magma Wyrm left behind. Still warm.

name: Emberheart Imp Crown Ring
description: The Imp Chieftain wore it as a crown. It is a ring.

name: Stormrider Lance
description: Crackles in the rain.

name: Stormrider Gale Bow
description: Arrows ride the wind. Sometimes the wrong wind.

name: Stormrider Lightning Rod
description: Strictly speaking, the lightning finds it.

name: Stormrider Rocfeather Cloak
description: Feathers from the Storm Roc. It has plenty more.

name: Stormrider Thunderhead Stone
description: Thunderhead dropped it. It still rumbles.

name: Glacierguard Greatsword
description: Cold enough to keep your lunch fresh.

name: Glacierguard Iceline Bow
description: The string never goes slack.

name: Glacierguard Frostglass Staff
description: Snowflakes fall wherever you point it.

name: Glacierguard Hydrascale Plate
description: One scale from each of the Glacier Hydra's heads.

name: Glacierguard Alpha Fang
description: The Rime Alpha's tooth, polished to a shine.

name: Deepdelver Pickaxe
description: Mines ore and enemies with equal joy.

name: Deepdelver Rivet Crossbow
description: Fires rivets. The mine has lots of rivets.

name: Deepdelver Lantern Staff
description: Never runs out of light. Or opinions.

name: Deepdelver Golemheart Plate
description: Built around a piece of the Iron Golem's core.

name: Deepdelver Foreman's Badge
description: Says "Employee of the Month". Every month.

name: Twilight Regalia Sword
description: Half day, half night, all edge.

name: Twilight Regalia Bow
description: Shoots arrows of dusk and dawn.

name: Twilight Regalia Orb
description: Shows the sky at the moment of eclipse.

name: Twilight Regalia Eclipse Plate
description: Scales of the Eclipse Dragon. The finest armor in the land.

name: Twilight Regalia Herald's Sigil
description: The Eclipse Herald's seal of office.

name: Forgeheart Amulet
description: Still warm from the anvil. Always will be.

name: Starforged Blade
description: Hammered from a fallen star on your own Forge.

name: Starforged Bow
description: The string is spun from starlight. Somehow.

name: Starforged Staff
description: Twinkles when it casts. Show-off.

name: Mirewalker Reedblade
description: Light as a reed, sharp as gossip.

name: Mirewalker Lantern Bow
description: Arrows glow like will-o'-wisps.

name: Mirewalker Willow Wand
description: A twig of the Whisperwillow. It still whispers.

name: Mirewalker Bark Robe
description: Woven from the Whisperwillow's bark. It hums lullabies.

name: Mirewalker Croak Stone
description: Old Croaker's lucky stone. Smells faintly of pond.

name: Fenwood Club
description: Carved from bog oak. Floats, oddly.

name: Bogwater Trident
description: Three prongs, all slightly muddy.

name: Cattail Bow
description: Strung with a very tough cattail.

name: Drizzle Sling
description: Flings raindrops really, really hard.

name: Lilypad Scepter
description: A frog sat on it once. Now it's magic.

name: Mistcaller Rod
description: Calls mist. The mist does not always come.

name: Waders of the Fen
description: Keep your feet dry. Mostly.

name: Firefly Jar
description: A jar of friendly fireflies. They help you aim.

name: Whisperwood Charm
description: Carved from a fallen Whisperwillow twig. It tells you secrets. Bad ones.

name: Cogwright Wrench-Axe
description: Tightens bolts. Loosens enemies.

name: Cogwright Rivet Bow
description: Fires rivets with a satisfying clank.

name: Cogwright Spark Coil
description: A coil of copper that hums with old magic.

name: Cogwright Furnace Plate
description: Plated with the Colossus's cooled furnace door. Toasty.

name: Cogwright Captain's Badge
description: Captain Clank's badge of office. He salutes it, even now.

name: Ruinstone Maul
description: A chunk of fortress wall on a stick.

name: Kilnfire Sabre
description: Glows like a kiln. Smells like toast.

name: Gargoyle Crossbow
description: Carved like a gargoyle. It glares at your targets.

name: Cinderbolt Bow
description: Each arrow leaves a little trail of smoke.

name: Rune-Brick Staff
description: A staff with an old rune brick on top. Heavy, but wise.

name: Bellows Wand
description: Squeeze it to fan your spells hotter.

name: Rivetmail
description: Mail made of a thousand old rivets. Clinks when you walk.

name: Oil Lamp Charm
description: A tiny lamp that never runs out. Probably.

name: Clockwork Heart
description: Ticks in time with yours. Slightly faster when you are brave.

name: Nightwatch Moonblade
description: Glows faintly when the moon is up. Sulks when it isn't.

name: Nightwatch Owl Bow
description: Fletched with owl feathers. Silent as a whisper.

name: Nightwatch Lantern Staff
description: A lamplighter's staff with a little moon inside.

name: Nightwatch Wyrmstar Cloak
description: Woven from the Moonwell Wyrm's starry scales. Twinkles.

name: Nightwatch Duskhorn Charm
description: A tip of Duskhorn's antler. It holds a single star.

name: Gloomcleaver
description: A heavy blade the color of midnight.

name: Rime Hatchet
description: Chops wood and freezes it at the same time.

name: Nightjar Bow
description: Shoots arrows you only hear after they land.

name: Icicle Repeater
description: Fires icicles. Reload with snow.

name: Starless Tome
description: A book of night. The pages are very hard to read.

name: Frostlight Wand
description: Glows like moonlight on fresh snow.

name: Owlfeather Coat
description: Keeps you warm and very, very quiet.

name: Moonpetal Pin
description: A flower that only opens at night.

name: Moonsilver Locket
description: Holds a tiny drop of the moonwell. It hums lullabies.

name: Sunseeker Khopesh
description: A curved blade that catches the sun. And the occasional mirage.

name: Sunseeker Dune Bow
description: Its arrows never miss in the desert. They might elsewhere.

name: Sunseeker Sunstaff
description: Topped with a sliver of the midday sun. Bring sunscreen.

name: Sunseeker Basilisk Mail
description: Golden scales from the Aurum Basilisk. Priceless, and very shiny.

name: Sunseeker Sphinx Riddle
description: A scroll with the sphinx's best riddle. Nobody knows the answer.

name: Dunebreaker
description: A sandstone maul. It breaks dunes. Mostly into smaller dunes.

name: Dawnglass Blade
description: Forged from desert glass that holds the sunrise.

name: Scarab Sling
description: Slings golden pebbles. The scarabs want them back.

name: Sunbeam Bow
description: Shoots arrows of pure sunlight. Very bright. Very fast.

name: Sandglass Orb
description: An hourglass that never runs out of sand.

name: Halo Scepter
description: Wears a tiny halo. Insists it is not a crown.

name: Nomad Wraps
description: Cool by day, warm by night, sandy always.

name: Oasis Charm
description: A drop of oasis water in a glass bead. Refreshing just to hold.

name: Sunforged Crown
description: Made from gold the Basilisk didn't need. It needed all of it.

name: Skyglass Saber
description: A blade of starglass. Rings like a bell when it hits.

name: Skyglass Longbow
description: Its arrows leave a little trail of sparkles.

name: Skyglass Rod
description: A rod of clear crystal with a tiny star caught inside.

name: Skyglass Warden Mantle
description: Woven from the Starwarden's crystal feathers. It counts things.

name: Skyglass Prism Charm
description: A chip of the Prism Stag's antler. Throws rainbows on everything.

name: Comet Cleaver
description: Swing it fast enough and it leaves a tail.

name: Starshot Bow
description: Every arrow is a tiny wish.

name: Nebula Wand
description: There is a whole sky in there. Do not shake it.

name: Starweave Robe
description: Light as starlight and nearly as warm.

name: Wishing Star Pendant
description: Make a wish. It will not come true, but it is nice to ask.

name: Fallen Star Circlet
description: Forged around a star that landed in your Roost. It hums when you think hard.

name: Riftstone Greatsword
description: Carved from rock that fell into the void and came back. It hums.

name: Riftstone Recurve
description: The arrows go a little further than they should.

name: Riftstone Wand
description: A shard of floating rock on a stick. It refuses to fall.

name: Riftstone Nullmaw Hide
description: Tough stone skin from the Nullmaw. It still rumbles when it's hungry.

name: Riftstone Strider Feather
description: A stone feather from the Voidstrider. Heavier than it looks, and it looks heavy.

name: Hollowfang
description: A blade with a hole down the middle. It cuts the air out of the air.

name: Echo Longbow
description: You hear the arrow land before you let go. Unsettling.

name: Null Scepter
description: Topped with a sphere of nothing. Do not look into it for long.

name: Chasm Plate
description: Heavy stone armor for walking near the edge.

name: Empty Locket
description: There's nothing inside. That's the point.

name: Abyssal Anchor
description: Forged to keep you from falling in. So far it works.

name: Tidecaller Cutlass
description: A pirate's blade from the drowned city. It drips, always.

name: Tidecaller Harpoon Bow
description: Fires little harpoons. Very good for fish. Also everything else.

name: Tidecaller Conch Staff
description: Hold it to your ear and you can hear the storm.

name: Tidecaller Coral Mantle
description: Cut from the Tidelord's coral crown. It still expects to be bowed to.

name: Tidecaller Ray Fin
description: A fin from the Thunder Ray. It crackles when it rains.

name: Breakwater Axe
description: Splits waves in two. Waves are not impressed.

name: Squallbreaker
description: A hammer that rings like thunder.

name: Spray Longbow
description: Every shot leaves a little rainbow.

name: Gale Repeater
description: Fires as fast as the wind can load it.

name: Drowned Tome
description: Waterlogged, but the spells still work. Mostly.

name: Stormglass Rod
description: A rod with a tiny thunderstorm trapped inside.

name: Sailcloth Coat
description: Waxed against the rain. Smells faintly of fish.

name: Pearl of Calm
description: Hold it and the storm feels far away.

name: Leviathan Crest
description: Forged from the Tidelord's old armor. It hums sea shanties.

name: Mirebloom Sickle
description: Found in Rotroot Thicket. Part of the Mirebloom set.

name: Mirebloom Reed Bow
description: Found in Rotroot Thicket. Part of the Mirebloom set.

name: Mirebloom Mushroom Staff
description: Found in Rotroot Thicket. Part of the Mirebloom set.

name: Mirebloom Bark Shroud
description: The Rotroot Thicket boss's trophy. Part of the Mirebloom set.

name: Mirebloom Ent Acorn
description: The Rotroot Thicket mini-boss's trophy. Part of the Mirebloom set.

name: Rotfang Cleaver
description: Its edge is a little bit rusty. On purpose.

name: Sporeshot Bow
description: The arrows burst into spores. Aim away from yourself.

name: Mildew Wand
description: Leaves a faint smell of old cheese.

name: Bogwalker Coat
description: Waterproof, mud-proof and very nearly smell-proof.

name: Clean Air Charm
description: A little sprig that keeps the spores away. Mostly.

name: Heartwood Talisman
description: Carved from a healthy piece of the Queen. It still grows a leaf now and then.

name: Pyreleaf Machete
description: Found in Emberwild. Part of the Pyreleaf set.

name: Pyreleaf Blowgun
description: Found in Emberwild. Part of the Pyreleaf set.

name: Pyreleaf Torch Staff
description: Found in Emberwild. Part of the Pyreleaf set.

name: Pyreleaf Volcano Plate
description: The Emberwild boss's trophy. Part of the Pyreleaf set.

name: Pyreleaf Tyrant Crown
description: The Emberwild mini-boss's trophy. Part of the Pyreleaf set.

name: Ashfall Blade
description: Still warm from the forge. Or from the volcano.

name: Canopy Longbow
description: Strung with jungle vine. Smells of flowers.

name: Magma Orb
description: Hold it by the cool end.

name: Heatproof Leathers
description: Doesn't burn. Doesn't breathe either.

name: Fire Orchid
description: A flower that blooms in lava. Keep it watered with lava.

name: Caldera Heart
description: A stone from the bottom of the volcano, forged into a pendant. It beats like a drum.

name: Ironclad Warblade
description: Found in The Steelspine Range. Part of the Ironclad set.

name: Ironclad Crossbow
description: Found in The Steelspine Range. Part of the Ironclad set.

name: Ironclad Lightning Rod
description: Found in The Steelspine Range. Part of the Ironclad set.

name: Ironclad Dragonplate
description: The The Steelspine Range boss's trophy. Part of the Ironclad set.

name: Ironclad Lynx Claw
description: The The Steelspine Range mini-boss's trophy. Part of the Ironclad set.

name: Girder Maul
description: A steel beam with a handle. Subtle it is not.

name: Bolt Thrower
description: Throws bolts. The metal kind, not the lightning kind.

name: Alloy Scepter
description: Three metals and a bit of luck.

name: Chainmail of Ages
description: Heavy, clanky and handed down through nine smiths.

name: Grounding Charm
description: Lightning goes around you. Mostly.

name: Dragonsteel Band
description: Forged from a scale Ferrovane let you keep. It's warm, and it hums.

name: Galeborn Cutlass
description: Found in Skyreach Isles. Part of the Galeborn set.

name: Galeborn Harpoon Bow
description: Found in Skyreach Isles. Part of the Galeborn set.

name: Galeborn Compass Staff
description: Found in Skyreach Isles. Part of the Galeborn set.

name: Galeborn Whalehide Coat
description: The Skyreach Isles boss's trophy. Part of the Galeborn set.

name: Galeborn Griffin Feather
description: The Skyreach Isles mini-boss's trophy. Part of the Galeborn set.

name: Dawnsteel Saber
description: Polished so bright you can comb your hair in it. Many do.

name: Sunray Bow
description: The arrows leave a trail of warm light.

name: Halo Rod
description: A ring of light floats above the tip. It hums when happy.

name: Skysail Jacket
description: Cut from an old sail. Catches the wind in all the right places.

name: Weathervane Charm
description: Always points toward trouble. Useful, and a little alarming.

name: Whalesong Pearl
description: A pearl Aurelith gave you, forged into a pendant. Hold it to your ear and you can hear the sky.

name: Riftwalker Glaive
description: Found in Twilight Rift. Part of the Riftwalker set.

name: Riftwalker Starbow
description: Found in Twilight Rift. Part of the Riftwalker set.

name: Riftwalker Orrery Staff
description: Found in Twilight Rift. Part of the Riftwalker set.

name: Riftwalker Night Mantle
description: The Twilight Rift boss's trophy. Part of the Riftwalker set.

name: Riftwalker Stalker Eye
description: The Twilight Rift mini-boss's trophy. Part of the Riftwalker set.

name: Meteor Blade
description: Forged from a fallen star. It still remembers the fall.

name: Constellation Bow
description: Strung with a line of tiny stars. Very hard to lose at night.

name: Galaxy Wand
description: A little swirl of galaxy lives in the glass tip.

name: Duskweave Robe
description: Woven from the last light of evening. It glows faintly in the dark, which is lovely until you try to sleep.

name: Quiet Stone
description: A pebble from the edge of nothing. It makes the world feel a little calmer.

name: Nightwing Sigil
description: Forged around a scale Nyxaris shed for you. Half of it shines and half of it is not quite there.

name: Deepcrown Warhammer
description: Found in Hollow Crown. Part of the Deepcrown set.

name: Deepcrown Crossbow
description: Found in Hollow Crown. Part of the Deepcrown set.

name: Deepcrown Lantern Staff
description: Found in Hollow Crown. Part of the Deepcrown set.

name: Deepcrown King's Mail
description: The Hollow Crown boss's trophy. Part of the Deepcrown set.

name: Deepcrown Chancellor's Quill
description: The Hollow Crown mini-boss's trophy. Part of the Deepcrown set.

name: Nightglass Sword
description: Black glass from the deepest mine. It never reflects anything, not even you.

name: Duskstring Bow
description: Strung with a thread of shadow. Silent as a held breath.

name: Gloomlight Scepter
description: It glows, but darkly. Your eyes hurt in a cozy way.

name: Delver's Coat
description: Many pockets, all of them full of string, chalk and emergency biscuits.

name: Everburning Candle
description: It never goes out. You have tried. Everyone has tried.

name: Crown of Echoes
description: A circlet forged from the Hollow King's crown. Say something into it and the kingdom whispers back.

name: Wellspring Trident
description: Found in The Confluence. Part of the Wellspring set.

name: Wellspring Geyser Bow
description: Found in The Confluence. Part of the Wellspring set.

name: Wellspring Kettle Staff
description: Found in The Confluence. Part of the Wellspring set.

name: Wellspring Hydra Scale
description: The The Confluence boss's trophy. Part of the Wellspring set.

name: Wellspring Coral Heart
description: The The Confluence mini-boss's trophy. Part of the Wellspring set.

name: Undertow Blade
description: Pulls a little toward the sea, wherever you are.

name: Sea Spray Bow
description: Every shot comes with a fine salty mist.

name: Whirlpool Staff
description: Stir your tea with it and the tea stirs back.

name: Steamproof Apron
description: Brindle's spare apron. Stained in eleven elements.

name: Mixing Vial
description: Two liquids that never quite mix, swirling forever. Calming to watch.

name: Twinflow Locket
description: Forged from a scale off each of Seethe's heads. One side is warm and one side is cool.

name: Starforged Blade
description: Found in Starfall Summit. Part of the Starforged set.

name: Starforged Longbow
description: Found in Starfall Summit. Part of the Starforged set.

name: Starforged Comet Staff
description: Found in Starfall Summit. Part of the Starforged set.

name: Starforged Night Mantle
description: The Starfall Summit boss's trophy. Part of the Starforged set.

name: Starforged Eclipse Ring
description: The Starfall Summit mini-boss's trophy. Part of the Starforged set.

name: Dawnsteel Sword
description: Forged at sunrise on the summit. It is always a little warm.

name: Shooting Star Bow
description: Every arrow leaves a short glittering trail. Make a wish.

name: Zenith Staff
description: Topped with a sliver of fallen star. It hums when the sky is clear.

name: Stargazer's Cloak
description: Orrin's spare cloak, embroidered with every constellation, some of them made up.

name: Wishing Shard
description: A shard of a fallen star. Nobody has wished on it yet. It is waiting for a good one.

name: Heart of the Sky
description: Forged from the core of Vesperax's last caught star. Hold it up at night and the sky holds still.

name: Eldest Greatsword
description: Found in Dragonsrest. Part of the Eldest set.

name: Eldest Hornbow
description: Found in Dragonsrest. Part of the Eldest set.

name: Eldest Nest Staff
description: Found in Dragonsrest. Part of the Eldest set.

name: Eldest Guardian's Plate
description: The Dragonsrest boss's trophy. Part of the Eldest set.

name: Eldest Keeper's Lantern
description: The Dragonsrest mini-boss's trophy. Part of the Eldest set.

name: Hollowpoint Blade
description: Its point is a tiny hole in the world. Do not look at it too closely.

name: Silent Bow
description: No twang, no whistle. The arrow just arrives.

name: Staff of Nothing
description: Topped with a perfect little nothing. It is heavier than it looks.

name: Nestkeeper's Coat
description: Soft, warm and lined with old dragon down. Smells faintly of eggshell.

name: First Scale
description: A single scale from one of the first dragons. It is still warm, after all this time.

name: Guardian's Beard Clasp
description: Forged from the iron clasp in Ossarion's beard. He said you could have it. He has a spare.
